  "recovered_c": "uint64_t fn_15(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  if (len == 0) {\n    return -1;\n  }\n\n  size_t encoded_len = 0;\n\n  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    if (out_cap < encoded_len + 2) {\n      return -1;\n    }\n\n    uint8_t count = 1;\n    while (i + 1 < len && in[i] == in[i + 1]) {\n      count++;\n      i++;\n    }\n\n    out[encoded_len++] = count;\n    out[encoded_len++] = in[i];\n  }\n\n  return encoded_len;\n}"
